reviewer: root Codex; directly inspected actual listed critical ranges
accepted: Every accepted DDR AR allocates one MemRead. Default head-only countdown ptw_latency=31 is charged per AR, followed by that burst through RLAST. This is explicitly plain C++ model delay, NOT MIG matched.
Default WREADY=1; optional W backpressure accepts 3/4 cycles. The every-two-slot W contract in B hand examples is not an actual default or newly executed DUT case.

Optional DS priority or distinct-full-ID round-robin with overlap can serve PTE between payload beats; neither withdraws held RVALID. RR updates on an actual R handshake; same ID retains oldest first.

Parent translation fixture receives a real normal TL response and caches its success and r/w permission under matching parent generation. It is a static-Normal prototype; no complete production access_ok/owned-result/invalidation contract follows.

shared_pretl_read repair_pair_authorized requires both own READ cache_valid, full source span and matching PA/attributes before resident or inflight attachment. Thus pre-grant capture/post-grant adoption is not established by the current join path.
Physical source AR offered fields remain held across first VALID. A late grant cannot cancel an already offered independent AR; proposed dispatch selection requires a pre-VALID gate.

idma_buffer exposes byte data/valid/ready only; it directly instantiates FIFO with flush tied0 and no quarantine/adopt metadata. Transport accepted R simultaneously pushes FIFO and updates source-progress signals. Zero-copy pre-grant raw adoption is not a transparent use of this existing interface.

TC saves ordinary TL response, substitutes PA into physical AR with original ID/length/attributes, and forwards accepted physical R to untranslated upstream response. COMPLETE ends on downstream AR acceptance, not RLAST. A downstream physical cache endpoint can serve an accepted AR locally rather than cancel it.

Current TC normal/error endpoint selection tests trans_resp_data.error (and MSI variant ignore/MRIF); physical completion output by itself is not a new explicit access_ok contract. This review does not assume an error-suppressed response proves actual authorization.

timing_gate.serial: If A cold READ leaf is queued behind V payload in the default model, its success cannot arrive before V RLAST. Early-grant/full-live-join examples therefore require an earlier usable grant or a genuinely legal interleaving service opportunity; no invented mid-burst PTW.
timing_gate.hardware: No new FPGA measurement of AR setup, write grant latency or DDR interleave was made.

scope: Read-only targeted inspection. No model/RTL/build/board rerun.
